description:
WHY IT WORKS NEUROSCIENCE BELOW ⬇️ 

Negative thoughts feel intense because your brain processes them as part of you. 

Seeing thoughts outside of you makes the brain separate you from the thought. This kills the energy feeding the thought as real. 

Move your thoughts away, throw them into the past and watch the power drain away ❤️

Check out the Ultimate mindset change podcast for mindset help,  contact link, community and newsletter link on bio.

#anxiety #stress #successmindset #overthinking #mindfulness
transcript: Now, here's an incredibly bizarre way to change your negative thinking forever. But if you're going to do this with me, please practice with something less intense first. Are you ready? Picture something that's worrying you and you'll notice that the thought will probably appear about here. Now, what I want you to do, as crazy as it sounds, is reach over with your hand, scrunch up the thought, and chuck it behind you. And now repeat. Bring up the thought as it appears, grab it, scrunch it up, and chuck it behind you. And you'll notice the more you repeat that, the energy from this thought begins to mysteriously disappear.
